d:
So, this is a wholesome soft-erotica yuri comic featuring an original story set 1 year after Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones ends.

A single Gorgon whose soul was cleanesd and whose intellect increased to human level is the master of a massage salon far away from civilization, and one day she receives the visits of a guest she respects the most, the one she owes everything to.

It will be quite a unique reading, little dialogue but intense yuri soft-core.

Also an Epilogue Artwork set 60 years after and a funny 8-panes koma super deformed comedic comic reinterpretaing the story of the comic.
